why: CurAction (+9). A virus's: BN5 numbers generic states 0-5 and its own from 6, BN6 generic 0-7 and its own from 8 (two status states, frozen and bubbled, between), so BN5's 0-5 are BN6's 0-5, its 6 BN6's 8, 7 on two up (every family table in both ROMs; the attack's end writes 6 at BN5 0x0800F2E2 and 8 at BN6 0x08011754). MegaMan's: ready 6 in BN5, 8 in BN6 (BN5_MEGAMAN_READY, BN6_MEGAMAN_READY), his others the same (a step 0x10, hit 3, seen in both traces). The same numbering holds for an attack of the third kind that runs the same states: its state table BN5's generic 0-5 and its own from 6, BN6's 0-7 and its own from 8 (t3_types; Handi's obstacle, the third kind's type 0x4B, run by BN5 0x08017FCC / BN6 0x0801B394 from its state table BN5 0x080CF118, 8 entries, BN6 0x080CF264, 10: its own 6 and 7 BN6's 8 and 9; the bomb BomBoy throws and BoyBomb sets, the third kind's 0x3E, its update BN6's twin 0x080CD4A8 in the one copy both run, the chips', from BN6's table: bomboy_v1 its bomb's 6 in BN5 and 8 in BN6 at t19; the cube a RockCube stands, the third kind's 0x59, run by the same routine from BN5's table 0x080D117C, 7 entries, BN6's 0x080D12B8, 9: chip_poltrgst its own 6 in BN5 and 8 in BN6 at t33; "0x59 twin": only where BN6's object runs BN6's own type, Colonel's moved copy of it keeping BN5's numbers, colonel_sp). MegaMan's actions of a family (CurAction from 0x10, run from each game's table of families, BN5 0x080EB514, Gregar 0x080EBFA0) by the twin of each: BN5's 0x1A, the Soul's unison and its end (the player update 0x08014604 sets it from AIData +0x44's bits 0x4000 and 0x40), is BN6's 0x1C, the Cross's and Beast Out's (its twin 0x08017BC0, the same steps); BN5's 0x1E, the plain charged shot (0x080ECAB8), is BN6's 0x16 (0x080ED140), the same phases but BN5's first: it tests the battle's flag 0x40 (0x080ECAE0) and fires at once where it is clear, where BN6's always waits 5 frames first (0x080ED168), so a charged shot parts the two games (no spec fires one: docs/devtools/differential.md). The step (0x10), the buster (0x11) and the Cannon's (0x14) are the same number in both. The first kind's +0x5D is a CurAction too, read the same way: a status saves the object's state word (+0x08: +0x09 its CurAction) at +0x5C as it takes it and restores it as it ends (the paralysis's, BN5 0x0800CB84-0x0800CB8C / BN6 0x0800E76C-0x0800E774, then CurAction 4; the restores, e.g. BN5 0x0801384E / BN6 0x0801575C: ldr r0,[r5,#0x5C]; str r0,[r5,#8]). A foe's attack family (CurAction from 0x10, run from each game's table of families) is the same number in both where BN6's family of that number is BN5's (the step 0x10, which the Dark Soul's moves take, 0x0800F280 / 0x080116F6), and BN5's family F that BN6 has none of, moved with the Navi that runs it, BN6's 0x50 + F in the grown table (families; src/emu/xnavi_recipe.h, XN_FAMILY_OF): the Navis' buster, BN5's 0x16, as 0x66; a virus's own action of a chip's family by its chip (chip_id). A Soul's charged shots run as the families the Souls track moved (S4: BN6's attack families grown, xattack_grow.c, the Souls' from 0xC0 in tools/xsoul.py's FAMILIES' order): BN5's 0x43 (ColonelSoul's) BN6's 0xC0, 0x3A (NumberSoul's) 0xC1, 0x40 (KnightSoul's) 0xC2, 0x50 (ToadSoul's) 0xC3, 0x3D (ShadowSoul's B+Left) 0xC4, 0x45 (TomahawkSoul's) 0xC5, and 0x13 by his attack (megaman_by_attack). A counter's two families (a hit taken in ShadowSoul's B+Left stance: BN5's 0x2C and 0x2D, twins of BN6's 0x47 and 0x48, started by BN5's 0x0800E338 and BN6's 0x080105F2, whose family's first frame the Souls' Thumb runs at once as BN5's: src/emu/soulcode.c's counter_code) are BN6's 0x47 and 0x48. A failed Chaos Unison's family (BN5's 0x39, 0x080EE724: the Dark Soul spawned, MegaMan out of the Soul) is BN6's 0xC7, Chaos Unison's Thumb (src/emu/soulchaos.c; xattack_grow.h's Souls' range), the same phases. BN5's family 0x49 (0x080EF270, the player's answer to his request 0x80000: BN5's DarkInvs's end, its time at 0, and Slasher's reaction) runs moved as BN6's 0x99 (the chips' Reaction49; src/emu/darkinvs.c starts it where BN6's twin starts BN6's own family 0x49, another: chip_darkinvs_end).

megaman_by_attack.why: Under BN5's chip AI (DarkInvs's machine, src/emu/darkinvs.c: his AI data +0xF0 1 while it is under way, which BN5 clears every other idle frame, 0x0802C03E) MegaMan fires the Navis' buster (BN5's setup 0x3E, 0x0800FAFE: family 0x16), as the Dark Soul does: BN6's engine runs BN5's family 0x16 moved with the Navis (XN_STUB_BUSTER, tools/bn5_navi_twins.py FAMILIES) as 0x66 (xnavi_recipe.h's XN_FAMILY_OF)

BN5's sword family (0x13, 0x080EBDC6) runs ShadowSoul's charged shot as its sub-family 2 (his AttackVars +3, AI data +0xA3, set by its power attack 0x0800F818) and the sword chips as the others; BN6's 0x13 is its own sword family (0x080ECAB6, no twin of BN5's), which BN6's sword chips run, so the Souls' copy of BN5's runs as 0xC6 (xattack_grow.h's Souls' numbers, tools/xsoul.py's FAMILIES): BN5's 0x13 is BN6's 0xC6 where his sub-family is 2, BN6's 0x13 otherwise

A sword chip charged with ShadowSoul united (his AttackVars +4 1, the chip's use's first argument: BN5 0x0800D9E8, BN6 0x0800FBEC) runs BN5's sword family in both, which takes ShadowSoul's paths: BN6's chip use returns the Souls' copy of it, 0xC6, for that chip (src/emu/soulchips.c)
